run_train_experiment: run the savi training experiment with a yaml config and model directory
run_eval_experiment: run the savi evaluation experiment with checkpoint interval and last checkpoint flag
find_best_ckpt_idx: find the best checkpoint index from tensorboard event files by spl metric
eval_best_checkpoint: evaluate the best checkpoint automatically selected from tensorboard logs
get_config: get experiment configuration from a yaml config file with command-line overrides
